headline: Approved Leftfield invoice for $64,349.00 and DesignLAB invoice for $68,100.00; adopted rules of operation and Library Building Project Plan.
summary: Members reviewed the Nashua Public Library renovation and addition, a project of about $44 million to $45 million, and heard a status update and timeline. They approved two invoices, the rules of operation, and the Library Building Project Plan, with Alderman Johnson opposed to each.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the June 24, 2026 meeting; motion carried.
Approved Leftfield invoice #196342 for services through June 30, 2026, for $64,349.00; motion carried with Alderman Johnson opposed.
Approved DesignLAB invoice #26.03-726 for services through July 15, 2026, for $68,100.00; motion carried with Alderman Johnson opposed.
Approved and accepted the rules of operation; motion carried with Alderman Johnson opposed.
Approved and accepted the Library Building Project Plan; motion carried with Alderman Johnson opposed.
